## Instructor with Full Responsibility

### Applied Business Economics (BECO 3310)
**Rawls College of Business, Texas Tech University** | Fall 2025

Fundamental principles of microeconomics applied to business decision-making, covering supply and demand, market efficiency, firm theory, and market structures.

<a href="beco3310.html" class="access-btn">Access Course Materials</a>

### Economics Seminar (2 sections)
**Universidad Francisco Marroquín** | Spring & Fall 2025

A discussion-based seminar exploring the theory of the entrepreneur, from Kirzner's opportunity discovery to Schumpeter's creative destruction and Baumol's productive and unproductive entrepreneurship.

<a href="seminario.html" class="access-btn">Access Course Materials</a>
